final: SELECT c.colour, COUNT(sh.id) as hero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(sh.id) DESC) as rank_val FROM superhero sh JOIN colour c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND sh.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.colour    -- returns 19 rows with eye color, count, and rank
